statements.english: over what to do with my room
statements.chinese: 关于如何处理我的房间。

statements.english: What ? Over a stupid room ?
statements.chinese: 什么？就为了一间破房间？

statements.english: l know , I feel kind of bad for them , but I also really excited
statements.chinese: 我知道，我为他们感到有点难过，但我也真的很兴奋，

statements.english: cause now l don't have to move in here !
statements.chinese: 因为现在我不用搬到这里来了！

statements.english: Oh , no . Yeah , that part's great
statements.chinese: 哦，不。不过那部分确实很棒。

statements.english: What's all this about you guys fighting ?
statements.chinese: 你们打架是怎么回事？

statements.english: ls this really over a room ?
statements.chinese: 这真的只是为了一个房间吗？

statements.english: I mean , that is so silly
statements.chinese: 我是说，这太蠢了。

statements.english: - Ross , We can handle this . - Apparently not
statements.chinese: Ross，我们能处理好这件事。 ——显然并没有。

statements.english: And l can't just stand by and watch
statements.chinese: 而我不能袖手旁观

statements.english: two people l care about so much ..
statements.chinese: 两个我非常在乎的人...

statements.english: ... be hurt by something that is so silly
statements.chinese: 被如此愚蠢的事情伤害。

that.definition: 关系代词，引导定语从句

statements.english: I mean , enough of the silliness
statements.chinese: 我是说，别再犯傻了。

statements.english: Why don't you tell her to stop being silly
statements.chinese: 你为什么不叫她别犯傻了。

statements.english: Two very good points
statements.chinese: 两个非常好的观点。

statements.english: Look , l've known you both a long time
statements.chinese: 听着，我认识你们俩很久了。

statements.english: And l've never seen either of you one- millionth as happy ..
statements.chinese: 而我从未见过你们俩有哪怕百万分之一的快乐...

statements.english: ... as you've been since you got together
statements.chinese: 就像你们在一起时那样

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成完成时态

statements.english: Do you really want to throw that all away over a room ?
statements.chinese: 你真的要为了一间房放弃这一切吗？

statements.english: That is so silly
statements.chinese: 这太蠢了。

statements.english: What's more important , love ..
statements.chinese: 更重要的是，爱……

statements.english: ... or silliness ?
statements.chinese: ...还是愚蠢？

statements.english: Well , we are fond of the silliness
statements.chinese: 好吧，我们就喜欢这种傻里傻气的劲儿。

statements.english: But we also have a soft spot for the love
statements.chinese: 但我们对爱情也有一份柔软的心。

statements.english: - Love is the best medicine . - That's " laughter ."
statements.chinese: 爱是最好的良药。——所谓‘良药’，就是‘欢笑’。

statements.english: - Why do you do it ? - l don't know
statements.chinese: - 你为什么要这么做？ - 我不知道。

statements.english: Now , Chandler
statements.chinese: 现在，Chandler，

statements.english: you want to live with Monica , right ?
statements.chinese: 你想和Monica一起住，对吧？

statements.english: Yeah , l do
statements.chinese: 是的，我愿意。

statements.english: And , Mon , you want to live with Chandler , don't you ?
statements.chinese: 还有，Mon，你想和Chandler一起住，对吧？
statements.phonetic: /ænd; ənd/ /mɑːn/ /juː; jʊ/ /wɑːnt/ /tuː; tə/ /lɪv; laɪv/ /wɪð; wɪθ/ /ˈtʃændlər/ /doʊnt/ /juː; jʊ/

statements.chinese: 在纽约州，口头协议具有法律约束力！

statements.english: So l understand you're looking for a place ?
statements.chinese: 那么我理解您正在寻找一个住处？

statements.english: No , no , l'm staying put
statements.chinese: 不，不，我要留在原地。

statements.english: l was going to offer you my apartment
statements.chinese: 我本想把我那套公寓让给你。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: Why ? Where you going ?
statements.chinese: 为什么？你要去哪儿？

statements.english: l don't know
statements.chinese: 我不知道。

statements.english: Hey , Rach
statements.chinese: 嘿，Rach。

statements.english: You are not goanna believe it
statements.chinese: 你绝对不会相信的。

statements.english: Monica and Chandler are moving in again
statements.chinese: Monica和Chandler又要搬回来住了。

statements.english: That's great news , right ? l mean , for them , right ?
statements.chinese: 这可是个好消息，对吧？我是说，对他们来说，对吧？

statements.english: But on the bright side , we get to be roommates again
statements.chinese: 不过往好的方面想，我们又能当室友了。

statements.english: Yeah . You know , about that ...
statements.chinese: 是啊。你知道的，关于那件事...

statements.english: Ross , l really appreciate your offer
statements.chinese: Ross，我真的很感谢你的提议

statements.english: to let me move in and everything ... but
statements.chinese: 让我搬进去还有一切……但是，

statements.english: - don't you think it's goanna be weird ? - Why ?
statements.chinese: - 你不觉得这会很奇怪吗？ - 为什么？

statements.english: Why ? Why would it .... Why would it be weird ?
statements.chinese: 为什么？为什么会...为什么会觉得奇怪？

statements.english: Well , you know , because of us
statements.chinese: 嗯，你也知道，这都是因为我们。

statements.english: Because of our history
statements.chinese: 因为我们的历史。
